name: H06_chandras_outrage_the_controller_is_read_as_the_spell_resolves
note: Chandra's Outrage: 'that creature's controller' is whoever controls the creature as the spell resolves. P0 casts it on the opponent's 5/5 and holds priority; in response P0 gains control of that creature (a steal). On resolution the creature is controlled by P0, so P0, not the opponent, takes the 2 damage (20 -> 18); the opponent's life stays 20; the creature, now P0's, has 4 damage marked.
